KOLKATA — PRESENT DAY
Surabhi. 31. Maid. Mother of two. Abandoned by a husband who found a newer wife.
Two kids. Rent due. No husband. Only these hands to keep us alive...
Rohan's 3BHK. He freelances. She rules the house.
Rohan, 34. Quiet money. Soft heart.
SURABHI! That floor is filthy! Are you blind?
And you, Rohan — stop staring into space and DO something!
I need this pay. Swallow it. Smile. Survive.
Jenny, 30. Chubby. Sharp tongue. Never soft.
Jenny — bedridden again. Door shut. House quiet.
She treats me like dirt... while he pays my salary.
Rich. Lonely. Soft for kindness. Easy bait.
Money. And revenge. Both.
THE PLAN
NEXT DAY — Low blouse. Soft knock. Calculated smile.
KNOCK KNOCK
Still sleeping. Perfect.
Door ajar. Soft snores. The coast is clear.
Now you will pay, bitch.
SMIRK
Living room. Sweep. Cleavage on display. He notices.
Hard days, sir... kids hungry. Husband gone.
Take this. ₹1000. Don't tell Jenny.
TUCK
Note slips into her bra. His eyes follow.
Another thousand. If you need money — tell ME. Not my wife.
Hooked already...
I've fallen for you, Surabhi. Jenny... she can't satisfy me.
Sir — if she finds out, she'll fire me!
I protect what's mine. You're safe with me.
Fish took the bait.
BOTH of you! Standing around like fools! WORK!
Yell all you want. I've already won.
Tonight... more than words.
Soon. Very soon.
He checks Jenny's door. Locked in her fog. Green light.
CREAK
Jenny's bedroom. Surabhi cleans. He grabs her.
Mmph—!
Not full undress — too risky. But...
God... his size—
She drops to her knees. He gasps her name.
Nothing like Jenny—! You're fire—!
SLURP
WHAT—?! YOU SLUT—!
GASP!
Jenny lunges. Hand raised. Fury white-hot.
DON'T TOUCH HER!
SHOVE!
Out. Now.
SLAM
Door shut. One hour. Alone. Revenge lands.
REVENGE
Surabhi stays. I married her — in every way that matters. Divorce me if you want.
Jenny pale. Nods. Master bedroom — Surabhi. Guest room — them.
She took the house. And him.
HAPPILY EVER AFTER...?
END #1
Next door. Every evening. Same red saree.
Come in. Don't just stand there.
4:45 PM. The doorbell.
Indu bai was back from the village.
Tu ja apna samaan rakh. Do glass thanda pani lekar aa mere kamre mein.
Ji chote sahab.
Dad's bedroom door opened.
Sushila first. Then him.
Go for it, son. If she gives you trouble, call the intercom.
Two glasses of cold water.
Pallu ko mat daal sar par. Maatha khulla rehne de, Indu.
Tu ye paani pee le Indu. Tu bahut thaki lag rahi hai.
Sahab, maa-baap ne mujhe ghar se nikaal diya. Woh mujhe dosh dete hain ki mera pati chala gaya.
Indu, tu bahut khoobsurat aur mast aurat hai. Tu mujhe bahut mast lagti hai.
Indu bai, kahan ja rahi hai tu!
A few minutes later, she came back. Head still uncovered.
Indu, tu apna juda khol. Mujhe apne khule baal dikha.
She was already at the mirror.
Uff, Indu. Chal mere saath kamre mein.
Sahab, koi dekh lega. Memsahib ya bade sahab pakad lenge?
Tu chinta mat kar. Memsahib Dilli gayi hai. Abb natak bandh kar.
Once the door was shut, there was no more running.
She followed him.
The bathroom door closed behind them.
Akhil's room. Morning.
I woke up knowing I could change anyone's mind.
I'm not using that on Kavya. Don't need to. She already wants me.
Kavya's flat. Evening. Door unlocked.
I told him you might come.
I can't stand this guy. You know that.
I've been waiting for this. Every time I saw you at work. I wanted you to pick it.
I'm picking it. I'm obsessed with you.
Don't stop.
I waited this long. Why would I stop?
Adarsh stays in the chair. Silent. Watching.
This is what I wanted. You. Not him.
Get over here.
I don't like you. At all.
I want you in this. Don't want it? Leave. Staying means you join.
Because you asked. Not because of him.
Send security up. 4B. Not an emergency. He can say no.
Kavya… you sure?
Yes. Come in if you want. Shut the door and go if you don't.
This is because of you. I wanted you. The rest is extra.
Look at me when you say that. Not him.
You already know who I'm looking at.
This is okay? — It's okay. Don't ask again.
After. Hair messy. Almost smiling.
Shall we do it again?
അഖിലിന്റെ മുറി. രാവിലെ.
ആരുടെയും മനസ്സ് മാറ്റാമെന്ന് എനിക്കറിയാം.
കാവ്യയോട് അത് വേണ്ട. അവൾ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ എന്നെ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു.
കാവ്യയുടെ ഫ്ലാറ്റ്. വൈകുന്നേരം. വാതിൽ തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
നീ വരുമെന്ന് ഞാൻ അവനോട് പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്.
എനിക്ക് ഇയാളെ സഹിക്കാൻ പറ്റില്ല. നിനക്കറിയാം.
ഇതിനായി ഞാൻ കാത്തിരുന്നു. ജോലിസ്ഥലത്ത് കാണുമ്പോഴൊക്കെ. നീ തന്നെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കണമെന്ന്.
ഞാൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുകയാണ്. നിന്നോട് ഞാൻ മതിമറന്നിരിക്കുന്നു.
നിർത്തരുത്.
ഇത്ര കാത്തിരുന്ന ശേഷം ഞാൻ നിർത്തുമോ?
ആദർശ് കസേരയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു. മിണ്ടാതെ. നോക്കി നിൽക്കുന്നു.
ഞാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചത് ഇതാണ്. നിന്നെ. അവനെയല്ല.
ഇങ്ങോട്ട് വാ.
എനിക്ക് നിന്നെ ഇഷ്ടമല്ല. ഒട്ടും.
നീയും ഇതിലുണ്ടാകണം. വേണ്ടെങ്കിൽ പോക്. നിൽക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ ചേരുക.
നീ ചോദിച്ചതുകൊണ്ട്. അവൻ പറഞ്ഞതുകൊണ്ടല്ല.
സെക്യൂരിറ്റിയെ അയയ്ക്ക്. 4B. അടിയന്തരമല്ല. അവന് വേണ്ടെന്ന് പറയാം.
കാവ്യ… ഉറപ്പാണോ?
ഉറപ്പ്. വേണമെങ്കിൽ കയറ്. വേണ്ടെങ്കിൽ വാതിൽ അടച്ച് പോക്.
ഇത് നിന്നെക്കുറിച്ചാണ്. ഞാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചത് നിന്നെയാണ്. ബാക്കി അധികം.
അത് പറയുമ്പോൾ എന്നെ നോക്ക്. അവനെയല്ല.
ഞാൻ ആരെയാണ് നോക്കുന്നതെന്ന് നിനക്കറിയാം.
ശരിയാണോ? — ശരിയാണ്. വീണ്ടും ചോദിക്കേണ്ട.
ശേഷം. മുടി ചുരുണ്ട്. ഏകദേശം ചിരി.
വീണ്ടും ചെയ്യാമോ?
